member.summary: Registers a new account as an Organiser or a Participant.
member.remarks: The role must be "Organiser" or "Participant". Organisers must also supply the organiser registration code, so nobody can simply promote themselves. The password is hashed before it is stored.

member.remarks: On success the API sets a secure, HTTP-only session cookie that keeps the user's authenticated state and role for all subsequent requests (Swagger UI sends it automatically).
member.response: Logged in. Returns the user's details.
